claim: On 1 May 2025 the Sri Lanka Army reported the release of 40.70 acres in three Jaffna land plots to civilian owners.

metric.denominator: three land plots released at the 1 May 2025 Jaffna ceremony
metric.basis: area reported by Security Forces Headquarters — Jaffna

bounded_by: Official self-reporting establishes the reported release event and area, not the completeness of land restitution across the north.
notes: Counter-evidence to a flat 'nothing moves' narrative.
